conventions.null: Unknown. Never treat null as a negative or a safe value.
conventions.basis: 'stated' = written in the source document. 'inferred' = derived by the group from the document's text or standard Windows/AD behaviour; verify before relying on it for a decisive fact.

reconstruction_notes: Built from the .docx. The document refers to an official windows_enterprise_environment.json fixture with 16 permitted flow records, named owners, exact site overlays and per-record dependencies; that fixture was not available.
Flows in this file are reconstructed from the 'Main paths' and 'Trust and administrative boundaries' text and are not the official 16 records.
Owners are null because the .docx does not list them.
Zone placement, dependencies and business-service mappings marked 'inferred' were added by the group.
